    <t s="2">And similarly, regarding the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">the connection between the higher soul and the soul within the body is through the drawing down of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="4">which, in general terms, is the Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="5">And this drawing down is achieved through the service of "with all your might,"</t>

    <t s="10">and the essence of the soul is Yechidah].</t>
    <t s="11">Based on this, it will be understood that the service of prayer provides the power for the work</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the connection between the transcendent and immanent levels is achieved through the drawing down of the Essence of Ein Sof, and similarly, the connection between the higher soul and the soul in the body is through the essence of the soul, the Yechidah, which is revealed through the service of "with all your might."

translations.translation: Now, it is known,
that for there to be a connection between the Surrounding and the Filling, it is through the drawing down of the Essence of the Ein Sof, which is above both Surrounding and Filling.
And similarly, regarding the soul,
the connection between the higher soul and the soul within the body is through the drawing down of the essence of the soul,
which, in general terms, is the Yechidah.
And this drawing down is achieved through the service of "with all your might,"
with every measure and attribute that He measures out to you, you should thank Him.
For the fact that one thanks the Holy One, blessed be He, for every measure and attribute equally, stems from the revelation of the Yechidah
[The soul within the body is Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah,
the higher soul is Chayah,
and the essence of the soul is Yechidah].
Based on this, it will be understood that the service of prayer provides the power for the work
(work and tremendous toil in a difficult battle)
in all three lines,
for the power to overcome all obstacles comes from the essence of the soul
(as mentioned above in section 9),
and through prayer,
the connection of the soul within the body
(Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah)
and the higher soul
(Chayah),
also draws down the revelation of the Yechidah.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that during the exile, prayer is loftier than in the Temple era, as the service of "with all your might" reveals the Yechidah directly through the concealment, bypassing the orderly path of love and fear.

translations.translation: b)
Now, it was explained above
(at the end of section 3),
that the main concept of subjugation
(and transformation)
and the drawing down that results from it, is during the time of exile.
And to note,
that this matter is also emphasized in prayer,
as the Tzemach Tzedek explains in the aforementioned discourse
that prayer during the time of exile is loftier than prayer during the time of the Holy Temple.
And as the Alter Rebbe wrote,
that during the time of exile,
Malchus itself is in the aspect of prayer.
For during the time of the Holy Temple, Malchus asks for its needs from Zeir Anpin, her husband
(meaning that the drawing down of light that is above the chain of descent into Malchus is through Zeir Anpin),
but during the time of exile, there is no need to draw down through the higher attributes.
And the Tzemach Tzedek explains in the discourse this matter in the service of man,
that during the time of the Holy Temple,
the elevation of the soul within the body to its root above was through love and fear,
but during the time of exile,
"My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the concealment of the level,"
when the love and fear of the soul are in concealment,
the advice is "Show me your appearance,"
"Appearance" refers to reflected light,
the service of "with all your might," which is beyond limitation, that is aroused through the concealment,
and through this, the elevation of the soul to its root is in a manner of skipping,
for this elevation is higher than the elevation through love and fear,
which is in order and gradation.
And it can be said,
that what is stated in the aforementioned discourse, that through the concealment of the exile one comes to "with all your might," which is the revelation of the Yechidah
(as above, end of section 11),
even though the connection of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah with Chayah
(even during the time of the Holy Temple)
is through the drawing down of the Yechidah
(as above, ibid.),
the difference is,
that during the time of the Holy Temple, the service itself is
(primarily)
the service stemming from Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah and the service stemming from Chayah,
except that the connection between these two services is through the drawing down of the Yechidah,
but during the time of exile,
when the service itself is in the manner of self-sacrifice,
the Yechidah itself is revealed.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation of the Yechidah through the service of exile elevates the Yechidah itself, and connects this to the three levels of the soul—Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah, and Yechidah—corresponding to portion, lot, and inheritance, with the ultimate goal being that the inheritance of the Yechidah is actualized through one's own effort.

translations.translation: c)
And it can be said,
that through the Yechidah coming into revelation by means of the service during the time of exile,
an elevation is effected in it.
For the ultimate intent of all matters in the world, and also of the soul, is for the sake of man's service.
Therefore,
that the revelation of the Yechidah is brought about through service,
is an elevation relative to the Yechidah as it is in itself.
And one can connect this with what is said before prayer: "Ashreinu, how good is our portion, how pleasant is our lot, and how beautiful is our inheritance,"
and the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Baal HaHilula, explains in his discourse beginning with this verse
the three matters of portion, lot, and inheritance,
having prefaced,
that in the soul of man,
there are two general levels.
That which lives essentially,
and that which lives to give life,
meaning the life-force that extends from the soul to give life to the body.
And within this life-force itself there are two levels.
A general life-force that gives life to all the limbs of the body equally,
and a particular life-force that is invested in each limb according to its function.
And similarly, regarding the soul
(the Divine soul),
there are within it
(analogous to)
these three levels.
The essence of the soul,
and that which illuminates within the body and the animal soul in a general way, because the body and the animal soul are not vessels for this light,
and that which is invested within the body and its animal soul.
And it is explained there,
that these three matters are portion, lot, and inheritance.
And it can be said,
that these three matters are
(in a general way)
Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah,
Chayah, and Yechidah.
And as is explained there,
that "our inheritance" is the point of Judaism that is in every Jew,
and it is known that the point of Judaism is the Yechidah within the soul.
And it is explained there,
that the fact that these three matters are listed here in ascending order,
is,
because the ultimate intent is,
that even the revelation of the point of Judaism,
although it is an inheritance, something that comes automatically,
should be through man's service with his own power.
